name: qfd_n59_qbank_b-qbb-COMMIT
purpose: QW-N59-4 (10-19) hardened split of native59 (Q.STA.N59) after the one-root safe4/4b CTS stalls (pin-flop spread 145/127, SS setup -635 at the Q-seat select, 10,330 s hold repair): Q-seat SRAM bank child (8 SRAMs, kept one-hot read face, registered outputs + dd/context relays); own centre-fed root; landed into the parent by lp.py (record results/arch/landed_parent_1018/qfd_native59_split_flat); parallel fallback: unclustered H-tree CTS.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_native59_qbank u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_native59_qbank.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x512_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x512_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_n59_qbank_b/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_n59_qbank_b/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_n59_qbank_b --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_native59_qbank --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x512_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
